title: Native Model-Output / Confidence Artifact Inventory
purpose: Inventory existing T2-T8 prediction, probability, confidence, ranking, and uncertainty artifacts without fitting models, calibration procedures, targets, thresholds, or universal confidence scores.

T4.error: ValueError('Object arrays cannot be loaded when allow_pickle=False')

interpretation_rules.blank_t8_score: A blank t8_score field is not evidence of confidence or calibration.
interpretation_rules.t6_observable_non_positive: observable_non_positive is not a true negative classification target.
interpretation_rules.t7_survival: T7 survival/time-to-event outputs must retain right-censoring semantics and must not be converted into ordinary binary confidence.
interpretation_rules.cross_task_confidence: Task-specific confidence/probability quantities are not assumed numerically comparable across T2-T7.
